content:
maria: Noticing a sharp increase in unique attributes from /v1/generate spans. prompt_text and user_id cardinality up by ~10x in the last hour. (screenshot)
observability-bot: alert: span-cardinality /v1/generate -> prompt_text uniques: 512k (1h)
ashwin: We should stop exporting raw prompt_text. Suggest HMAC with env-specific key and only export prompt_hash.
kevin: Hash helps cardinality but breaks ability to join traces to billing tables. For request_id we need a way to correlate during incident investigations.
jessica: Privacy note: raw prompts are sensitive. HMAC with KMS-managed key + strict retention looks good. Truncation alone is reversible for short texts.
maria: Proposed exporter scrub rules:
```
if span.attrs['prompt_text']:
  span.attrs['prompt_hash'] = HMAC_KMS(span.attrs['prompt_text'])
  delete span.attrs['prompt_text']
span.attrs['hashed_user_id'] = HMAC_KMS(span.attrs['user_id'])
write request_id to short_term_encrypted_cache(ttl=24h)
```
ashwin: Implementation detail: do the scrub in the OTEL exporter pipeline so traces never leave the cluster with raw fields.
kevin: For dashboards we should expose only truncated_prompt_id (first 12 hex chars) to reduce cardinality. Also add a guard in Grafana to refuse queries that request high-cardinality aggregations.
jessica: If we ever capture raw prompts for QA/regression, it must be explicit per-project opt-in, encrypted at rest, and TTLed. 1% sampling default if enabled.
maria: UX note: Console toggles needed: "Include prompt hash in traces" and separate opt-in for "Store raw prompts for QA" with approval flow.
kevin: Operational concerns: collisions on truncated ids acceptable for grouping but not for authoritative joins. Use full HMAC for billing joins (never shown in dashboards).
ashwin: I'll add integration tests for the exporter scrubber and a small local demo trace. PR ETA EOW.
jessica: I'll update the telemetry privacy docs and add language for sales/legal teams about retention windows.
maria: Action items:
- ashwin: scrubber PR + tests (due EOW)
- kevin: list dashboards referencing raw fields + migration PRs (due Tue)
- jessica: privacy doc + opt-in workflow (due EOW)
- maria: write RFC recommending defaults: no raw prompts in traces, prompt_hash via KMS, request_id encrypted 24h, 1% opt-in for raw capture
observability-bot: linked: https://redwood-internal/ops/telemetry/high-cardinality-rfc
kevin: I'll also add an alert if unique truncated_prompt_id grows >50%/day to catch leaks.
jessica: LGTM. This should cut Tempo cost and address compliance. :thumbsup:
maria: Filing RFC now and will tag you all. Thanks!
